title: decision: DID sig verification strips header from article bytes before verifying
description: In post/did_verify.rs, verify_did_sig strips the X-Stoa-DID-Sig header from article_bytes before verifying, reproducing what the author signed. The test verify_did_sig_strips_header_before_verifying confirms this. The byte-level strip_did_sig_header correctly handles non-UTF-8 body bytes (regression test present). Design is correct.
